security_model: two pinned semi-honest non-colluding peers; untrusted opaque relay

implemented_not_promoted.reason: the Chisq cell-product, GLM weighted-residual and binomial-softplus producers are manifest-bound, but remaining legacy producers and their workload E2E certification are incomplete

glm_adapter_blockers.current: GLM input sharing, eta, gradient, aggregation and session slots accept only Ring63 or Ring127 records
glm_adapter_blockers.required: one canonical variable-width Ring63-through-Ring4096 record/session adapter selected before any shares are created

glm_adapter_blockers.current: k2-compute-eta-fp uses asymmetric local truncation for public beta times protected X shares
glm_adapter_blockers.required: producer-bound exact public-scalar mul-truncate plus certified accumulation bounds for every eta coordinate

glm_adapter_blockers.current: most exp, sigmoid and reciprocal polynomial products enter exact GC through the legacy analyst-selected slot binder; only selected GLM softplus and weighted-residual products have producer manifests
glm_adapter_blockers.required: one-shot producer manifests and intermediate bounds for every product, public scaling and approximation-domain edge

glm_adapter_blockers.current: k2-full-iter-r3 accumulates Beaver matvec products and applies asymmetric local truncation in Ring63 and Ring127
glm_adapter_blockers.required: purpose-bound exact dot-product/matvec chunks with checked accumulators and exact truncation

glm_adapter_blockers.current: only input bounds and finite result postconditions are execution-bound
glm_adapter_blockers.required: operation-complete intermediate attestation, aggregate error bound, estimator error bound, convergence and identifiability certificate, and plaintext-reference E2E oracle

certified_workloads.numeric_scope: one unsigned Ring127 Count share per peer, public unit-capacity bound, unit replacement sensitivity and the allocator-minted epsilon/delta policy
certified_workloads.arithmetic: the exact GC reconstructs the Count only inside the circuit, combines one private seed contribution from each peer, samples one bounded discrete-Laplace/geometric variate, adds it and saturates exactly to [0, unit_capacity]
certified_workloads.release: only identical durable releases signed independently by both pinned peers are accepted; the relay never receives either source share, seed contribution, noise variate or output share

certified_workloads.numeric_scope: aligned finite one-hot inputs, Ring63/f20, n <= 2147483647 and K*L <= 4096
certified_workloads.arithmetic: producer-bound direct-wide checked multiplication, exact floor truncation and proved non-wrapping count accumulation
certified_workloads.release: exact count vector remains sealed; the data-dependent guard bit is disabled and a fixed-shape joint differentially-private clamp/noise/opening is required

promotion_blockers: exactGCVecmulBindInputsDS remains exposed only for unmigrated legacy workloads and still accepts analyst-selected session slots
all remaining checked-multiplication producers must mint one-shot manifests before the legacy bind endpoint can be removed
remaining checked-multiplication workloads do not yet have a certified E2E oracle
the published exact domain ends at Ring4096 and public operand bounds at 1200 decimal digits; larger bound combinations fail typed rather than wrapping
circuit shapes are bounded by explicit typed-input and multiplication-bit work budgets; these are infrastructure limits, not request quotas
